verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a speech-to-text API platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an isolated sandbox, test mode, or separate environment that keeps testing away from production data. The no-code Playground is a way to try transcription, not an isolated sandbox, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
